description: [1/2] Add a Bestiary tab to the Memories codex: every one of the 97 enemy records is listed with regular enemies before guardians, a first kill stores the def id in Meta.bestiary and announces itself, and a recorded species reveals its field-guide line while unknown ones stay sealed. bestiaryEntries sorts and filters phantom saved ids; memoriesScreen takes the saved record and switches panels through Memories/Bestiary tabs. impact_assessment.why: The Memories screen only showed lore, so the 97 defeated species had no codex and a first kill said nothing about the record it created.
impact_assessment.benefits: Players can see what they have met, guardians are separated from mobs, unknown entries tease the deep, and the first kill is announced and persisted.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: Meta gains bestiary (defaults []); dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: old saves default the empty record; UI: the Memories screen gains a second panel and tab row.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Schema default plus phantom-id filtering, a 5-case suite, source/CSS wiring assertions, and browser checks at desktop and phone widths before the UI task closes.
